summary: 10.0.38.06 Comprehensive Light Mode Polish, Zero-Glitch Focus Engine, Universal 100% Single-Row KPI Ribbon Parity, Master Data 50% Category Rail Expansion, and Controller Robustness
highlights: 1. Focus Flash Glitch Fix: Scoped dark active input rules away from light mode and eliminated CSS background transitions to completely prevent the blank/black input flash on click.

2. Universal KPI Ribbon Parity: Extended KpiCardEnhancer to .standard-kpi-card with flex 1 1 0 and proportional expansion, eliminating right-side white voids across Item Master, Barcode Studio, Stock Register, General Ledger, Data Import, and Reports.
3. Manual Match Candidate Modal Parity: Top 6 KPI cards strictly stay in a single row without wrapping card #6, and cleaned up dark inlines.
4. Master Data Categories Rail Expansion: Increased left category panel width by 50% to 345px with full container width to eliminate dead white space.
5. Items Master Delete Button Fix: Added single-row auto-fallback and AppDialogService confirmation modal so Delete button never fails silently.
6. GSTR-1 Subtab Coordination: Synchronized GSTR-1 subtab button styles and active purple gradients with click handlers.

7. Modals & Settings Light Mode Parity: Cleaned up hardcoded dark backgrounds on Party/Item/Audit modals, settings branding/SMTP/signature panels, and fixed notification/module checkbox pill text contrast.
